name: UlyssesModel/kirk-mcp
description: Sealed density-operator ML engine for cross-section entropy scoring on financial data. Validated bit-exact against QuantBot FY24 top-512 golden across 252 trading days. First 100 inference units free per new account.

authentication.notes: Service token via Cloudflare Access headers CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret. First 100 inference units free per new account — contact sales@kavara.ai for token provisioning.

examples.title: Score one order-book snapshot
examples.prompt: Use kirk_score_book to score a snapshot with bid/ask prices against model kirk-qb-trial-v1

examples.title: Bulk score without burning LLM tokens
examples.prompt: Call kirk_bulk_howto first to get a Python client, then run scoring locally at zero LLM-token cost per iteration

examples.title: Verify engine identity
examples.prompt: Call kirk_healthz to verify the sealed engine sha matches Kavara's published manifest
